highlight_metric: End-to-End ML Pipeline • Exploratory Data Analysis
subtitle_id: Pipeline Analisis Data Eksploratif, Rekayasa Fitur & Pemodelan Machine Learning
subtitle_en: End-to-End Exploratory Data Analysis, Feature Engineering & ML Pipeline
description_id: Proyek capstone pembelajaran intensif data science Bengkod yang mencakup pengolahan data mentah, penanganan missing values dan outlier, rekayasa fitur statistik, pemodelan prediktif machine learning terawasi, serta visualisasi insight data interaktif.
description_en: Data science and machine learning capstone project covering raw data preprocessing, outlier and missing value mitigation, statistical feature engineering, supervised predictive modeling, and interactive visualization dashboards.
architecture_id:
1. Pipeline Data Science

  • Data Wrangling: Imputasi data, normalisasi MinMax/StandardScaler, dan deteksi korelasi fitur.
  • Machine Learning: Benchmark algoritma klasifikasi (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM).
  • Evaluasi: Cross-validation k-fold, ROC-AUC curve, dan feature importance extraction.
architecture_en:
1. Data Science Pipeline

  • Data Wrangling: Automated imputation, feature scaling, and multi-collinearity analysis.
  • Modeling: Benchmarked classification models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM).
  • Evaluation: K-fold cross-validation, ROC-AUC profiling, and feature importance attribution.
